# Clerk

> > Clerk provides authentication and user management infrastructure for modern web applications, specializing in Next.js, React, and B2B SaaS integrations.

Clerk offers developer-first authentication with support for SSO, organizations, billing integration via Stripe, and comprehensive SDKs for frameworks like Next.js and Express. The platform emphasizes security best practices, multi-tenancy, and seamless integration with tools like Supabase and GitHub.

## Key Topics

- Authentication and user management
- Next.js and React integration
- Clerk Billing and Stripe subscriptions
- B2B SaaS and multi-tenancy
- Organizations and team management
- SSO (Single Sign-On)
- API key authentication
- JWT and session management
- Row Level Security with Supabase
- Payment processing and feature gating
- OTP (One-Time Password) authentication
- Subscription management
- Security compliance (NIST 800-63B)
- Personal accounts and default settings
